prior_credit: Published period key: George Lasry, Ingo Niebel, Nils Kopal and Arno Wacker (2016), and George Lasry (2017). Earlier repository OCR and local native/tail trials are retained. Source review, priced proposals and verification: icekylinx and GPT-6 Astra Pro. No universal first-decipherment priority is asserted.
limits: One surviving second part is reviewed; no missing first part is invented.
The five added coordinates are separate from two printed dashes. Four added slots and one source dash are filled by the word proposal; the remaining source dash and first added slot stay unknown.
All untouched numerical fields, the shortened KRIEGSZUSAND and source-compatible ZIMNICA remain literal. No historical date, hour, modern place spelling or army unit is supplied.
The five unfilled published square cells remain coupled and injective. Complete-square witnesses demonstrate domains and exact re-encryption, not a historical digit assignment.
The source text and printed note support the selected terminal-loss frame; a complete geometry search or unique original-message recovery is not claimed.
